description: Keeps the digest-pinned base images, the pinned GitHub Actions and the pinned CI tool versions current. Cargo and npm dependencies are deliberately not managed here (lockfiles are reviewed by hand).

packageRules.description: cargo-audit's output is parsed by .github/release/audit-bin.sh; a new version can change the strings it matches.
prBodyNotes: **Re-check `.github/release/audit-bin.sh` against this cargo-audit version.** It greps the output for: `Updating crates.io index`, `couldn't update/open crates.io index`, `couldn't check if the package is yanked`, `Found 'cargo auditable' data`, `security advisories`, `error: N vulnerabilities found` and `N denied warnings`. A changed string would make the enforced audit fail open or closed. Run the real tool on a built binary and `.github/release/tests/run-all.sh`.

packageRules.description: ci.yml downloads the prebuilt git-cliff of this version and checks its sha256 from a file.
prBodyNotes: **Update `.github/release/tests/git-cliff.sha256`** with the sha256 of `git-cliff-<version>-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz` from the release page: the release-scripts CI job downloads that binary and fails on a mismatch or a missing entry.

packageRules.description: The Rust toolchain, Node and the PostgreSQL test matrix move with rust-toolchain.toml, flake.lock and the support policy, never on their own; digest refreshes of the pinned tags still flow through.

customManagers.description: Tool versions annotated with `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...`: release.yml (KEY: "version", optionally followed by KEY: "sha256:digest") and the Dockerfiles (ARG KEY=version).
ci.yml tool versions, matched by name because ci.yml carries no annotations.
